finding.title: The `filename` parameter is directly used to open a file.
The `fillColor`, `strokeColor`, and `markerId` parameters are directly inserted into the SVG file without any validation or sanitization.
The `markerStart` parameter is directly used in the `marker-start` attribute without any validation or sanitization.
The `markerId` parameter is directly used in the `marker` element without any validation or sanitization.
